title: Israeli Strikes and Gunfire Kill Four Across Gaza
detail: Israeli strikes and gunfire killed at least four Palestinians and wounded 15 others across the Gaza Strip on Tuesday, September 8, 2026, despite the ceasefire. A drone strike hit a tent sheltering displaced people on Jules Street, north of the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza, killing one person and wounding 12 (11 admitted to Al-Awda Hospital). In the Al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis, Israeli forces shot and killed a child, Obeida Osama Sheikh, in the chest. Ramzi Abu Reeda, a former political prisoner, died from wounds sustained in earlier bombardment in Khan Younis, and 70-year-old Fathi Ahmad Mahmoud Abu Ayada died from gunfire wounds in the Al-Maslakh area south of Khan Younis. A separate strike hit a house in Khan Younis, and another hit the rooftop of a home belonging to the Ferwana family near Sheikh Radwan Cemetery, Gaza City, wounding a Palestinian. Medical sources at Nasser and Al-Shifa hospitals reported additional casualties. Palestinian officials said the incidents were among 16 new violations of the October 2025 ceasefire agreement.

media.caption: Israeli strikes and gunfire kill four across the Gaza Strip, Sep 8, 2026
